sents.en: Jupiter is a planet.
Planets orbit stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Jupiter is the fifth closest planet to the sun.
sents.ko: 목성은 태양에서 다섯 번째로 가까운 행성이에요.

sents.en: It is about 484 million miles (779 million km) away from the sun.
sents.ko: 태양에서 약 4억 8,400만 마일(7억 7,900만 km) 떨어져 있어요.

sents.en: Jupiter orbits the sun very slowly.
One year on Jupiter is about 12 years on Earth.
Jupiter spins while it orbits the sun.
sents.ko: 목성은 태양을 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: The spin makes day and night.
Jupiter spins very fast.
One day on Jupiter is about 10 hours on Earth.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
It is 2.5 times bigger than all of the planets combined!
sents.ko: 다른 행성을 다 합친 것보다 2.5배나 커요!

sents.en: Jupiter is a giant ball of gas.
You cannot stand on Jupiter.
Jupiter has many storms.
There is lightning on Jupiter.
There are very fast winds too.
There is a red spot on Jupiter.
This spot is one giant storm.
It has lasted for hundreds of years!
You can see Jupiter in the night sky.
Wow! This book taught us a lot about Jupiter.
sents.ko: 와! 이 책은 목성에 대해 많이 알려 줬어요.

sents.en: Do you remember everything?
Jupiter is the biggest planet.
What else?
I think you remember a lot.
Okay. I'll see you next time! Good-bye!
